name: Uono Yuuta
source:
A tuna keeper at the Funtra Aquarium who has been involved since its establishment. A
human with a strong sense of mission and seriousness. He's kind only to his tuna-mermaid friends and only allows himself to cry around them.

Favorite food: Hot cake

Birthplace: Chiba Prefecture

Special skil: Recognize all tuna individually

Favorite time: Checking the aquarium before opening

[Translated from [url=https://tonleiter-p6.com/fantasticstrans/index_magu.html#character]the official website[/url]]
